findings.title: Missing React key for Grafana rule list items
findings.body: In the rules map, the 'grafana' case returns GrafanaRuleListItem without a key prop, while the datasource and unknown cases do pass key. Because this list is incrementally appended during infinite scrolling, missing keys can cause incorrect React reconciliation, reused DOM/state, and hard-to-debug rendering bugs.

findings.title: Delete action is hidden for ruler-less Grafana rules even when permitted
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu computes canDelete from both ruler abilities and Grafana Prometheus abilities, but the Delete menu item is only rendered when rulerRule is truthy. In the new alert list view, Grafana rules are rendered from promRule only, so rulerRule is undefined. Users with delete permission will not see Delete, breaking the intended removal of ruler API dependency.

findings.title: Silence menu item can be shown but clicking it does nothing for ruler-less rules
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu renders the Silence notifications item based on canSilence, which can be true from Grafana Prometheus abilities, and handleSilence sets showSilenceDrawer to true. However SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer is only rendered when rule is a Grafana ruler alerting rule. In the ruler-less list view rule is undefined, so clicking Silence opens no drawer and the action silently fails.

findings.title: Pause action unavailable for ruler-less Grafana rules despite computed ability
findings.body: canPause can be true via useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities, but the pause menu item additionally requires rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule). In the new list view rulerRule is undefined for Grafana Prometheus rules, so Pause is not shown even though the ability hook says it is supported/allowed. This makes pause functionality regress when ruler requests are removed.

findings.title: Federated ruler rules are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: useAllRulerRuleAbilities now hardcodes isFederated = false, whereas the previous combined-rule ability logic used isFederatedRuleGroup. Federated rules should be immutable in the UI, but this change can make edit/delete/duplicate abilities appear supported for federated ruler rules. Since useAllAlertRuleAbilities still delegates to this hook, existing views may inherit the regression.

findings.title: skipToken does not actually skip Grafana abilities and can grant Duplicate incorrectly
findings.body: useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities converts skipToken to undefined, but useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) still returns abilities such as Duplicate based on Grafana create permissions. In AlertRuleMenu, abilities from ruler and Grafana hooks are OR'ed, so non-Grafana rules could show Duplicate based on Grafana-internal permissions or when ruler abilities deny it. skipToken should result in all abilities being [false, false].

findings.title: View link no longer includes returnTo navigation parameter
findings.body: The removed GrafanaRuleLoader implementation created the rule view URL with returnTo, but GrafanaRuleListItem now builds /alerting/grafana/:uid/view without it. If the rule viewer or back-navigation logic still relies on returnTo to return to the list/folder context, this change will lose the return location.

findings.title: Grafana rule key contains an extra trailing brace
findings.body: getGrafanaRuleKey returns `grafana-${namespace.uid}-${groupName}-${rule.uid}}`, which includes a literal trailing '}' after the uid interpolation. This is likely a typo and produces malformed React keys if the helper is used for keys.

findings.title: Clipboard write promise rejection is unhandled
findings.body: copyToClipboard calls navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text).then(...) without a catch handler. If clipboard access is denied or fails, the promise rejection is unhandled and the user receives no feedback.

findings.title: Inline actions arrays defeat memoization in ability hooks
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu passes newly created action arrays to useRulerRuleAbilities and useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities on every render. Those hooks memoize based on the actions array identity, so the memoization is ineffective and abilities are recomputed for every rule row on re-renders, which may matter on large alert lists.

findings.title: Test normalizes missing Delete action despite granting delete permissions
findings.body: The test grants AlertingRuleDelete and folder delete permissions, then expects exactly four menu items and does not expect Delete. This encodes the current behavior where Delete is missing for ruler-less Grafana rules instead of validating the intended RBAC behavior. It also does not click Silence, which would expose the no-op drawer issue.

findings.title: Stale comments/variable name about ruler preloading
findings.body: The code and comments still refer to preloading ruler rules and use cacheAndRulerPreload, but the ruler prefetch was removed in this change. This is misleading for future maintainers.
